messages:
jordan: EOD standup — quick sync on kernel/batching/KV/perf. What I did: landed kernel hotfix to reduce slot-steal in microbatcher (PR merged), ran end-to-end perf bench on raptor-128. Result: ~8% p95 improvement on dedicated nodes. Blockers: canary failing on shard-7 (OOM when seq_len=4096) — need repro. Today/tomorrow: dig into shard-7 trace, try repro with debug build, and coordinate KV toggle fallback behavior.

sana: Nice work. From logs the allocation spike looks like it comes from the allocator at t=0 during KV prefetch. I pushed a debug build with extra GC/allocation metrics to the canary. @lee can you confirm the pod config I pushed to canary? https://ci.internal/reports/6998

lee: On it. I pulled the canary config — one thing I noticed: the batching heuristic is producing a lot of tiny batches (<4 tokens) under low QPS, which hurts KW throughput. I'll try increasing `batch_hold_ms` from 8 -> 12 on the canary and re-run the smoke bench tonight.

mika: Bench notes: command I used: `./bench --model raptor-128 --seq 2048 --clients 64 --runs 200`. Median latency ~72ms, p95 ~186ms on the dedicated nodes after the kernel patch. Memory profile looks stable except the shard-7 run which spikes at ~1.9GB. Suggest trying quant profile `q4_0` on the dedicated bench nodes for another datapoint (should cut memory).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for cluster us-west-2, id c-20260319-22, image=redwood/runtime:v2026-03-19-kernel-hotfix. Status: rolling -> 12/24 pods updated.

jordan: Quick question: should we revert the KV prefetch feature toggle? It saves ~12% CPU overall but cold-start latency increased ~30ms p95 in the bench. My thought: keep it but add an automatic fallback to synced fetch when p95 > 350ms for >= 5m. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

sana: I agree keep + fallback. I'll add a metric-driven flag in runtime to flip to synced fetch when the sliding p95 crosses 350ms for 5min. Also will emit an event to tracing so we can correlate with OOM runs.

lee: I'll add the canary config for the fallback policy (and a knob to tune the 5m window). @mika can you add an eval prompt set that targets cold-start/cold-cache behavior so we can catch regressions?

mika: Done — added `kv_cold_start_set_v2` to the evals repo and wired it into the nightly pipeline. Also created a short smoke script: ```
# smoke cold-start
for i in 1 2 3; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.internal/generate -d '{"model":"raptor-128","prompt":"<kv_cold_probe>"}'
  sleep 6
done
```

jordan: Solid. Blocker recap: if we can repro OOM on shard-7 with debug build tomorrow we'll triage; if not, plan is to roll back the kernel patch and re-land after a smaller diff. For today: hold on broad rollout, let canary run with increased `batch_hold_ms` and fallback flag enabled. Thanks team — ping here if canary shows >5% p95 regressions. :thumbsup:
